mentions.heading: Environmental, health and safety compliance costs and liabilities
mentions.detail: Unknown contamination clean-up, fines; costs not covered by indemnities or insurance borne fully
mentions.quote: To the extent that we face unforeseen environmental or health and safety compliance costs or remediation expenses or liabilities that are not covered by indemnities or insurance, we may bear the full effect of such costs, expenses and liabilities, which could materially adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.

mentions.heading: Our failure to comply with anti-corruption laws could result in penalties
mentions.detail: FCPA exposure including via intermediaries and acquired businesses
mentions.quote: If we are not in compliance with the FCPA and other laws governing the conduct of business with government entities (including local laws), we may be subject to criminal and civil penalties and other remedial measures, which could have a material adverse impact on our business, financial condition, results of operations and liquidity.

mentions.heading: Changes in tax legislation or exposure to additional tax liabilities
mentions.detail: Global transfer pricing exposure; OECD BEPS; FDII deduction could shrink if customers move manufacturing to U.S.
mentions.quote: Most of our income is taxable in the United States with a significant portion qualifying for preferential treatment as foreign-derived intangible income (“FDII”). If our customers move manufacturing operations to the United States, our FDII deduction may be reduced.

drivers.name: base erosion and profit shifting project
